name: Edioff/booking-scraper
what_it_holds: Async Playwright-based Booking.com scraper: multi-city search, detail extraction, pricing, amenities, reviews, with anti-bot handling. MIT, 3 stars, updated Aug 2026.
why_useful: More technically capable scraper (handles anti-bot measures, multi-city) than the simpler BeautifulSoup scripts; if a repeated price panel were ever authorized this is a more robust starting point.

name: omkarcloud/booking-scraper
what_it_holds: Open-source scraper/client targeting Booking.com search and hotel-detail pages: extracts hotel name/address/coordinates, star rating, review scores and sub-scores, live nightly/total pricing for given dates and currency, room types/bed configurations, amenities, up to 60 photos, guest reviews (25/page), Q&A, and nearby-landmark distances. No committed dataset — sample JSON response structures only. Repo shows minimal traction (1 star, 0 forks, 5 commits visible), license not clearly stated.
why_useful: Another scraping method option for a Booking.com price panel; no data committed.
themes: Booking.com datasets beyond the 515k reviews: listing/price snapshots, alternative-accommodation counts, Booking scrapers, WSDM/RecSys Booking challenge data
why_all: Another scraping method option for a Booking.com price panel; no data committed.

A working method for pulling live Booking.com nightly prices/availability by date/market, which is the kind of realised-price signal called out in gap #2 (realised ADR/occupancy proxies) if run responsibly and periodically — but it is unrun, thin, and would need a terms-of-service decision before any pull.

name: pixelcrash/Sync-Rentals-Calendar
what_it_holds: Self-hosted tool to synchronize iCal rental-availability calendars across Airbnb, Booking.com, and other platforms. No committed dataset — it is calendar-sync infrastructure a host would run, not a data mirror.
why_useful: Illustrates that Booking.com (and other STR/OTA platforms) expose iCal calendar feeds per-listing similar to Airbnb's; conceptually this is the mechanism by which one could build a Booking.com occupancy/availability panel analogous to Inside Airbnb calendars, addressing gaps #2 (realised occupancy) and #9, but requires a host's private iCal URLs, not a public bulk source.
